title: Development of Heterocyclic PPAR Ligands for Potential Therapeutic Applications.
authors: Virendra, Sharma Arvind; Kumar, Ankur; Chawla, Pooja A; Mamidi, Narsimha
one_liner_zh: 该文综述杂环PPAR配体开发，虽涉及核受体转录因子但聚焦小分子药物设计，未研究蛋白质-DNA互作或结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: The family of nuclear peroxisome proliferator-activated receptors (PPARalpha, PPARbeta/delta, and PPARgamma) is a set of ligand-activated transcription factors that regulate different functions in the body. Whereas activation of PPARalpha is known to reduce the levels of circulating triglycerides and regulate energy homeostasis, the activation of PPARgamma brings about insulin sensitization and increases the metabolism of glucose. On the other hand, PPARbeta when activated increases the metabolism of fatty acids. Further, these PPARs have been claimed to be utilized in various metabolic, neurological, and inflammatory diseases, neurodegenerative disorders, fertility or reproduction, pain, and obesity. A series of different heterocyclic scaffolds have been synthesized and evaluated for their ability to act as PPAR agonists. This review is a compilation of efforts on the part of medicinal chemists around the world to find novel compounds that may act as PPAR ligands along with patents in regards to PPAR ligands. The structure-activity relationship, as well as docking studies, have been documented to better understand the mechanistic investigations of various compounds, which will eventually aid in the design and development of new PPAR ligands. From the results of the structural activity relationship through the pharmacological and in silico evaluation the potency of heterocycles as PPAR ligands can be described in terms of their hydrogen bonding, hydrophobic interactions, and other interactions with PPAR.
abstract_zh: 核过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体家族（PPARalpha、PPARbeta/delta 和 PPARgamma）是一组配体激活的转录因子，调节体内不同功能。已知 PPARalpha 的激活可降低循环甘油三酯水平并调节能量稳态，而 PPARgamma 的激活则带来胰岛素增敏作用并增加葡萄糖代谢。另一方面，PPARbeta 激活时增加脂肪酸代谢。此外，这些 PPAR 已被声称可用于多种代谢性、神经性和炎症性疾病、神经退行性疾病、生育或生殖、疼痛及肥胖症中。一系列不同的杂环骨架已被合成并评估其作为 PPAR 激动剂的能力。本综述汇集了全球药物化学家寻找可作为 PPAR 配体的新型化合物的努力，以及关于 PPAR 配体的专利。结构-活性关系和对接研究已被记录，以更好地理解各种化合物的机制研究，这将最终有助于新 PPAR 配体的设计与开发。从结构-活性关系的结果，通过药理学和计算机模拟评估，杂环作为 PPAR 配体的效力可描述为它们与 PPAR 的氢键、疏水相互作用及其他相互作用。
